checks.avigad: Bene Ḥezir façade centre about 50 m from Absalom and about 20 m from Zechariah (p. 37); façade faces south-west (p. 37)

registration.method: Porch centre = centroid of the OSM outline of the tomb (a 7–8 × 2–3 m strip along the façade). Façade normal = mean of the perpendicular to the outline's long sides and the bearing that puts Zechariah's centre where Avigad's plan puts it. Path level = modern terrain (Mapterhorn) at Absalom's mapped centre, Absalom standing on the valley floor.

The Haram's south-west and south-east corners, measured on Warren Pl. VII (line fits on the 600 ppi mask) and taken from OpenStreetMap (relation 5862584), fix the model: its frame (the plate at its own scale bar, turned by its north arrow) is turned so that the two south walls agree and moved so that their midpoints coincide.

The plan is matched to Vantor WorldView-2 imagery (Esri World Imagery, 21 October 2023, 0.5 m, stated accuracy 5 m) by searching the turn, scale and shift that put its dark pixels on the imagery's edges (tools/imagery_registration.py fit), then checked by overlay and an independent part or source.
registration.uncertainty_m: about 2 at the buildings; the imagery's own stated accuracy is 5
